summary: The fix removed the retired Nextcloud Talk export from the CI guardrail and made three unused type exports private.
reasoning: The diff for #174306 removes the re-export and moves inbound delivery to deliverNextcloudTalkReply. The guardrail in the fix's parent still required an exact export list containing the retired helper, so the reported failure was a stale CI expectation. The remaining changes only remove export modifiers from unused types.
